svg.text: G3 | Beam, internal nut blocks and ballast attachment
GANTRY / G1 | ORIGINAL DESIGN | dimensions mm unless stated
Unbuilt fixture. Dimension labels govern; do not scale this engineering sheet.
MIT original assets. No vendor CAD. Tolerances and manufacture in fabrication/README.md.
Beam20 x20 x400, nominal2 wall. Smooth tube, not an unreported slotted profile.
Tube Z13..33
Nut block Z15..21
Two M3x12 countersunk bolts from below each cap, axes X+/-5,Y+/-170.
Cap4.75 + tube bottom2 leaves about5.25 engagement in a6-thick nut block.
Nut blocks15.5 x12 x6; M3 tap through. Inspect actual tube cavity fit before assembly.
Ballast outer envelope40 x50 x40: X10..50,Y+/-25,Z13..53 at beam centre.
Two M4x30 bolts from beam faceX-10 into ballast atY+/-15,Z23.
Ballast tap M4 x12 deep; beam clearance dia4.5 and flush90-degree head seats.
Sleeves dia8/dia4.5 x16, X-8..8. AtX-8:90-deg entry relief dia5.3 x0.40.
No pivot connects beam/carriages: seat and inspect rigid fixings against340 mm jig.
Carriage pitch340 +/-0.03; relative yaw<=0.02 deg; top coplanarity<=0.03.
The0.8 kg mass and0.2 friction remain model estimates. Weigh/test the physical assembly.
Holes/hollows/flush fixings are manufacturing detail omitted from enclosing native solids.
No simulation score, evidence hash, instruction or runtime parameter is changed.
